name: quinones-claude-plugins
description: Jacob Quinones — Claude plugins. Local-first, MCP-driven tools for product workflows.

plugins.name: resume-studio
plugins.description: Local-first job-application workspace. Tailor your master resume against any JD, render the diff inline as an artifact, export to DOCX/PDF, and track applications on a kanban — all through Claude. Ships 4 skills (parse-resume, summarize-jd, tailor-resume, review-variant), 15 MCP tools across resume / applications / variants, and 1 SessionStart bootstrap hook. Optional Electron viewer in the same repo.

plugins.name: math-mcp
plugins.description: Math + finance MCP server. 16 named tools — Excel-compatible finance (PMT, FV, PV, NPV scipy + Excel conventions, IRR, XIRR, NPER, RATE) with Newton+bisection IRR/XIRR solvers and analytic-derivative RATE; statistics (summary, percentiles, correlation, linear regression with documented NaN edge cases); unit conversion; arbitrary-expression calculate fallback; and a list_functions discovery tool that browses the underlying mathjs catalog (~250 functions). Custom TVM math means Claude calls finance_pmt with named arguments instead of writing Python and flipping sign conventions. mathjs sandboxed to disable import/createUnit extension hooks. Ships pre-bundled (no install step needed).

plugins.name: team-skills
plugins.description: Shared team skills for product workflows. Ships the `plan` skill: bootstrap and maintain product plans under docs/plans/<slug>-plan/plan.md. Greenfield plans ALWAYS run a mandatory debate loop between two proposer agents (simplest vs. most robust) refereed by a critique-only debater that never picks a winner — only the user does. Improvements ask first whether to debate or single-shot, and auto-archive superseded plans with a timestamped plan-archive/ pattern. Bundled in this repo (local source) so the set can grow without separate repos.
